<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*Approximately two million [[Ford F150]] trucks are recalled due to a manufacturing error which can cause the [[Seat_belt#Pretensioners_and_webclamps|seat belt pretensioner]] to ignite the vehicle. [https://www.npr.org/2018/09/06/645284416/two-million-ford-trucks-recalled-due-to-reported-seat-belt-fires (NPR)]
*[[Trans Mountain Pipeline#Expansion project|Trans Mountain Pipeline expansion]]
**[[Kinder Morgan]] hints at a potential offloading of [[Canada]] assets following sales of the [[Trans Mountain Pipeline]] expansion project to the [[Government of Canada|Canadian government]]. [https://vancouversun.com/commodities/energy/kinder-morgan-weighs-full-exit-from-canada-after-trans-mountain-pipeline-debacle/wcm/789343e3-9a2d-430a-83f8-ba6d4336d133 (''Vancouver Sun'')] [https://www.thestar.com/business/2018/09/06/kinder-morgan-considers-selling-remaining-canadian-assets-after-trans-mountain-sale.html (''Toronto Star'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi earthquake]]
**A magnitude 6.7 earthquake strikes the island of [[Hokkaido]] in [[Japan]], killing 16 people, injuring 120 more and leaving 26 missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45443188 (BBC)]
*[[List of earthquakes in 2018|Earthquakes in 2018]]
**A magnitude 7.8 earthquake occurs off the coast of [[Fiji]]. The [[Pacific Tsunami Warning Center]] says no tsunami is expected due to its depth. [https://bnonews.com/site/index.php/2018/09/major-earthquake-strikes-off-the-coast-of-fiji/ (BNO News)] 
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**Spanish rescuers find five dead migrants and 53 survivors in a boat partially sunk in waters east of the [[Strait of Gibraltar]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/spain-finds-dead-migrants-rescues-hundreds-days-57640470 (ABC News)]
*[[2018 North Korean floods]]
**Heavy [[floods]] in [[North Korea]] leave at least 76 dead and 75 missing. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-northkorea-floods/flooding-kills-dozens-in-north-korea-thousands-left-homeless-red-cross-idUKKCN1LM1RV (Reuters)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]], [[2017–18 North Korea crisis]]
**[[North Korea]]n leader [[Kim Jong-un]] and [[President of South Korea|South Korea president]] [[Moon Jae-in]] agree to hold a [[September 2018 inter-Korean summit|third summit]] between September 18 and September 20 in [[Pyongyang]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna906946 (NBC News)]
**Kim gives a timeline for denuclearization, aiming for completion by the end of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s first term. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea/north-koreas-kim-sets-denuclearization-time-line-prompting-thanks-from-trump-idUSKCN1LM07M (Reuters)]
*[[Eritrea–Ethiopia relations]]
**Ethiopia reopens its embassy in the Eritrean capital [[Asmara]]. After the 1998-2018 [[Eritrean–Ethiopian War]], both countries signed a [[2018 Eritrea–Ethiopia summit|peace accord in July 2018]]. Also in July, Eritrea reopened its embassy in the Ethiopian capital [[Addis Ababa]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/09/ethiopia-reopens-embassy-eritrea-thaw-ties-180906082705189.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[LGBT rights in India]]
**The [[Supreme Court of India]] strikes down [[Article 377]], a colonial-era law which criminalized homosexuality, declaring it unconstitutional. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-45429664 (BBC)] 
*[[Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal]], [[2018 Amesbury poisonings]]
**[[Ben Wallace (politician)|Ben Wallace]], British [[Minister for Security|Security Minister]], says in an interview that [[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] bears the responsibility for multiple Novichok poisonings in the U.K., in which British citizens were harmed and killed. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-45429894 (BBC)]
*[[6 September 2018 Cincinnati shooting]]
**A gunman kills three people and injures two others at the [[Fifth Third Bank]] headquarters in [[Cincinnati]], [[United States]], before police fatally shoot him. [http://www.foxnews.com/us/2018/09/06/active-shooter-reported-at-bank-building-in-downtown-cincinnati-police-say.html (Fox News)]
*[[Sony Pictures hack]], [[WannaCry ransomware attack]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice|Justice Department]] unseals charges made in June against an alleged hacker for the [[North Korea]]n government in connection with a series of cyber attacks, including the [[Sony Pictures hack|2014 assaults]] on [[Sony Pictures]]. The [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] accuses Park Jin Hyok of conspiring the hack on behalf of [[Reconnaissance General Bureau]], the country's intelligence agency, and conspiring to commit wire fraud. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/justice-department-to-announce-hacking-charges-against-north-korean-operative-the-charge--stemming-from-the-2014-sony-pictures-case--is-the-first-against-a-pyongyang-spy/2018/09/06/f477bfb2-b1d0-11e8-9a6a-565d92a3585d_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Nisour Square massacre]]
**The second trial of [[Americans|U.S. citizen]] Nicholas Slatten, the former [[Blackwater (company)|Blackwater]] (now [[Academi]]) employee who was found guilty in 2013 of first-degree murder in connection to the [[List of massacres in Iraq#2000s|killing in 2007]] of fourteen unarmed civilians on [[Baghdad]]'s Nisour Square and sentenced to life in prison, ends in a mistrial. [https://www.npr.org/2018/09/06/645176400/blackwater-guards-2nd-murder-trial-ends-without-a-verdict (NPR)]
*[[Trump administration family separation policy]]
**The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] proposes regulatory changes which would allow the children of [[illegal immigration to the United States|illegal immigrants]] to be imprisoned for more than 20 days. [https://www.npr.org/2018/09/06/645195329/trump-administration-proposes-rule-to-allow-longer-detention-of-migrant-children (NPR)]
*[[Mexican Drug War]] 
**[[Mexico|Mexican]] officials report the discovery of the remains of at least 166 people in a mass grave in [[Veracruz]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45442402 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
* [[Ñuble Region|Ñuble]] becomes the 16th region of Chile after new [[Administrative divisions of Chile|administrative divisions in Chile]] come into effect. [https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/nacional/region-de-nuble/2018/09/06/los-hitos-que-marcaran-el-primer-dia-de-nuble-como-la-nueva-region-del-pais.shtml (Biobío)]
*[[Jair Bolsonaro presidential campaign, 2018]]
**[[Brazil]]ian presidential candidate [[Jair Bolsonaro]] is stabbed in the abdomen and seriously injured at a campaign rally. He is expected to be in [[intensive care]] for at least seven days. Police arrest a 40-year-old man they say appears mentally disturbed. [https://apnews.com/amp/e4ec161a5c20414c8922776376a71dec (AP)]

;Science and technology
*[[Discoveries of exoplanets]]
**[[Wolf 503b]], a [[super-Earth]] [[exoplanet]] twice the size of [[Earth]], is discovered orbiting {{ill|Wolf 503|ru|Вольф 503}} 145 light years away by American, German, and Canadian researchers via the [[NASA]] [[Kepler Space Telescope]]. [http://www.foxnews.com/science/2018/09/06/exoplanet-twice-size-earth-discovered-145-light-years-away.html (Fox News)] [https://www.astrobio.net/also-in-news/twice-the-size-of-earth-new-exoplanet-discovery-ideal-for-detailed-characterization/ (Astrobio)]
*[[Twitter suspensions]]
**[[Twitter]] permanently suspends the accounts of far-right conspiracy theorist [[Alex Jones]] and his website [[InfoWars]]. According to Twitter, the accounts were suspended under their policies against abusive behavior. [https://www.politico.com/story/2018/09/06/alex-jones-infowars-twitter-809364 (Politico)]
